skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and methods of real estate valuation, including income capitalization, residual method, and profit method.
Apply financial analysis techniques to real estate valuation, including income and expense projections.
Prepare and present real estate valuation reports.
Analyze and solve complex real estate valuation problems.
Work effectively in teams to complete valuation projects.
Communicate valuation findings clearly and persuasively.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics in real estate valuation.
Manage the process of real estate valuation projects.
